user_reported_bug: Collect PRC button not working on dashboard — 'button dead — कोणतीच action hot नाही' (nothing happens on click). Root cause: ForcedAdInterstitial was only mounted in the idle-state return branch of MiningWidget, so during an active mining session the modal never renders when forcedAdOpen=true. Fixed in v1.4.1 by mounting the modal in the active-session return branch too.

rca_of_the_issue: Prior RCA was correct: the active-session return path did not include ForcedAdInterstitial, so setting forcedAdOpen had no rendered modal. The v1.4.1 change mounts ForcedAdInterstitial in the active-session branch, closing the dead-button symptom while preserving the 25s safety net. Regression steps verified: seed active session, login, open dashboard, click Collect, observe modal immediately, complete ad fallback, collect PRC successfully.
